immutable_runtime_freeze.scope_observed: provider-generic Stage-1 --api-once plus snapshot/Tier-2 closure; normal service remains Clerk/PTTY -> Claude Code

source_findings.stale_generation_abort: TurnLifecycle abort/StopFailure and stale-predecessor paths are generation-fenced on the donor lane so stale work remains for canonical recovery rather than being terminalized by a stale hook.
source_findings.logical_snapshot_checkpoint_race: checkpoint() and logical snapshot validation share one canonical state-hash authority; copied snapshot bytes must equal the bound checkpoint state hash rather than merely contain the checkpoint row.
source_findings.tmux_secret_boundary: ambient service credentials were found able to enter persistent tmux control/server processes because subprocess.run lacked an explicit environment; donor lane constrains tmux control/server environment to PATH/TERM/LANG.
source_findings.claude_readiness_secret_boundary: claude --version readiness probe inherited ambient service credentials; donor lane constrains readiness subprocess environment.
source_findings.stage2_terminal_path: donor lane implements selected API provider as the sole process/pane of the same canonical per-user tmux session reached by the existing Clerk/WebSocket/PTTY ingress; it uses the same ClayVerseEngine/UnifiedDB/EffectGate path and no second WebSocket/state/effect authority.
source_findings.provider_secret_transport: provider API credential remains in the service-side inference/broker boundary; the tmux-side provider client receives only a Unix-domain socket path and is rejected if provider token environment is present.
source_findings.peer_fence: service-side Unix broker uses Linux SO_PEERCRED and an exact registered canonical pane PID rather than UID-only admission.
source_findings.same_uid_secret_hardening: Stage-2 API terminal mode requires Linux PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 before terminal children exist so same-UID terminal processes do not rely only on environment sanitization for the service secret boundary.
source_findings.tmux_attach_falsifier: an earlier provider-window design was rejected after primary tmux documentation showed attach-session targets a session; donor path was simplified to one canonical provider process/pane in the canonical session.
